evidence.evidence_text: To address the above problems, we propose a Structure-based Pseudo Label generation (SPL), which first generate free-form interpretable pseudo queries before constructing query-dependent event proposals by modeling the event temporal structure.
Experiments on the ActivityNet Captions and Charades-STA datasets demonstrate the advantages of our approach.
